scope: Read-only manifest and pure scoring-function audit; no records, rules, predictions or model-selection criteria changed.
primary_semantics: Decimal-normalized value equality after whitespace/currency/comma removal; percent suffix preserved. This is not literal identifier transcription accuracy.

records.question: What is the Catalog # for Zeroing Solution?
What is the Catalog # for VariClean Solution

interpretation: A prediction 81120 receives Decimal exact credit for the annotated account code 081120; 3310710 receives credit for catalog code 03310710. None of these three annotations explicitly contains the stripped-zero form as an alias.
The two fields of every candidate pair remain numerically distinct, so leading-zero normalization cannot turn a wrong-field/swapped identity into correct purely by making the two targets equal.

Primary results assess numeric-value binding with a limited code subset; they cannot claim exact preservation of all identifier characters. A literal comparison on code-like fields would be a secondary sensitivity only.

The builder unit labels are lexical screening categories, not semantic ground truth. Its identifier regex misses account/voucher/catalog, all classified number; this audit adds a separate descriptive lexical count without changing selection or records.
